newsitem.title: USA: Jury selection ends first week in secondhand-smoke suit.
newsitem.headline: Jury selection ends first week in secondhand-smoke suit.

text.p: The judge in a $5 billion second-hand smoking lawsuit against cigarette makers Friday added five people to the court's pool of standby jurors, bringing their total to 25.

In the lawsuit, 60,000 non-smoking flight attendants allege that Philip Morris and other tobacco companies are liable for smoking-related illnesses, including lung cancer, they contracted while working aboard U.S. passenger jets.
Lawyers questioned more than 75 potential jurors this week and are expected to question dozens more on Monday and Tuesday, before breaking for week because of a Jewish holiday.
